name: Companion Auto Summon for No Man's Sky
gameplay_verification_scope: Final combined 0.8.7-r1 launched on 28 September 2026 with production 0.4.9. Player confirmed visible Random summons after save load and ship exit in the Space Anomaly; logs confirm native location 14, accepted queues and expected active indices for different pets. One later manual-dismissal check had no apparent reappearance per player; duration not independently timed. No fix or repeatability is established for the earlier intermittent 0.8.4 failure. Full gameplay, controls, icons/HUD, other locations/modes and multiplayer remain unverified. See docs/research/LIVE-087.md.
previous_live_result: 0.4.0 applied Random and successfully summoned slot 3 from three eligible owned pets on a planet, confirmed by the user; manual favorite slot 1 stayed in runtime. 0.3.3 verified station summoning and restart restoration, 0.3.2 planetary summoning. These observations do not validate the new 0.4.1 biome preference. In combined play trial 0.6.1, 0.4.2 registered with automation ON and the log recorded an accepted station queue after ship exit at 20:18:19 on 27 September 2026; actual appearance was not separately confirmed.
actual_framework_import_and_gui_properti: Passed with the real pyMHF 0.2.4 and DearPyGui: eight widgets constructed and preference callbacks exercised with temporary files, no viewport, hook registration, native game calls or game launch
launcher_validation: 0.8.7 passed 333 production and 675 developer tests, real-framework offline checks and Python/Windows PowerShell 5.1 read-only preflights. Final r1 launched through the guarded PowerShell persistent PTY after normal game closure and a fresh verified 46-file backup; two Mods and twelve targets registered. This does not establish portable installer acceptance.
biome_preference: Optional and default ON, only in Random on PlanetOnFoot. Prefer eligible owned pets whose native habitat matches the normalized current planet habitat; fallback to the full eligible pool if unknown or no match. Ignored in stations/Nexus and last-manual mode. A chosen pet remains fixed during deferred retries.
deferred_summon: No default deadline; native eligibility and placement still required. Probe pairs paced at 0.5 seconds. Rejected requests retain the same choice until success or cancellation.
controls: CompanionAutoSummon tab in the separate pyMHF window; no mod hotkey
legacy_data_directory: NMS-AutoPet is intentionally retained for settings, remembered companions and the existing development runtime; schemas and file contents are unchanged.
startup_summon: One opportunity after successful local save load with automation enabled. No native summon calls during deserialization. Resolve a saved identity or Random through later local ownership updates and existing 1.5-second stability/placement checks; respect active/queued pets, preview, manual choice, ship entry, settings changes and context replacement. Never rearm merely because a pet is absent.
startup_summon_verification_scope: One Random-mode startup on a space station: save load armed at 20:42:58.578, location enum 2, request accepted at 20:43:01.261, user confirmed actual pet appearance. Nexus was explicitly not the test location.
manual_dismissal_verification_scope: Not live-verified for 0.4.5; no automatic retry or timing change is intended.

previous_production_verification.scope: 0.4.3 in combined play trial 0.6.2 registered with automation ON and two Mods/ten managed hooks on 27 September 2026. One on-foot station load in Random armed via save load (no ship-exit trigger before that startup request), chose slot 1 from five eligible owned companions, and queued it after 2.69 seconds. The player confirmed actual appearance. The player later confirmed one manual dismissal without reappearance after traveling in the unchanged session; exact dismissal location and duration were not independently measured. This does not verify Nexus/planet startup, Last manually selected startup, broader dismissal regression, biome preference, multiplayer or all settings.
previous_production_verification.manual_dismissal_scope: One player-reported manual dismissal without reappearance during combined 0.6.2 / production 0.4.3. The suggested check was about ten seconds on foot, but exact location, timestamp and duration were not independently measured. Travel separated this from the initial station load; no claim of a controlled immediately-after-startup dismissal test.

previous_developer_native_menu_trial.basic_toggle_evidence: Partial player report of ON ship-exit summoning and later OFF suppression, matching queue/apply logs and an OFF menu/HUD screenshot. Initial OFF attempt is ambiguous; first logged exit followed an ON change. Rapid toggles were repeated presses, not held-input validation.
open_live_defects: Player saw no pet after Anomaly startup although the native queue accepted slot 2. Runtime currently ends intent at queue acceptance without observing subsequent activation; cause inside the game is unresolved.
A solid white disc appears above the otherwise visible HUD status text; icon/render suppression has not been validated.
previous_developer_native_menu_trial.scope: Separately built, predicate-gated native ON/OFF candidate. Requires same-menu false then true native confirmation, one matching selected-child trigger and original false result; no tail-only activation. Existing production applies and persists the queued setting. Other preferences remain in the temporary development panel. Registered on 27 September 2026 after normal exit and a fresh verified backup: two Mods, 11 hook targets, automation ON and 14 unchanged payloads. Complete live preference validation, remapping/controllers and held input await testing.

developer_native_menu_trial.scope: Launched final r1 branding candidate with production 0.4.9 and menu 0.8.5-branding. Runtime behavior is AST-identical to 0.4.8 after excluding only new product/author/version metadata and the diagnostic version marker. Passed 333 production and 675 developer tests, real-framework offline discovery/shared dispatch/all six temporary preferences, and Python plus Windows PowerShell 5.1 read-only preflights. Native captions, preferences and summon behavior are unchanged; no new habitat mode is implemented. Final r1 includes a Korean grammatical correction after renaming; the 24 focused locale tests and combined framework/preflights were rerun successfully. Initial 087 is superseded and unlaunched.
developer_native_menu_trial.production_byte_identity_reference: Version and author/product metadata changed from 0.4.8; behavior unchanged
developer_native_menu_trial.live_scope: 28 September 2026: two Mods/twelve targets registered; automatic Random spawn after Nexus save load and ship exit confirmed by player and logs. Full native settings, HUD/icon rendering, resource teardown and input acceptance remain incomplete. No running payload or preference was overwritten.
developer_native_menu_trial.language_observation_scope: One bounded observation reported native region 0 ENGLISH with prior initialization/load seen. Text unchanged; no reload safety, automatic catalog choice or translated rendering claim.
developer_native_menu_trial.native_automation_toggle_scope: Player confirmed OFF prevented a ship-exit summon, ON alone did not summon and the next ship exit summoned. Logs: OFF 11:13:04.257, ON 11:13:39.076, next exit armed 11:13:56.061, slot 4 accepted 11:13:57.638 with expected active index 3. Other logged preferences unchanged; automation left ON. Other controls, restart persistence and alternate input unverified.

post_queue_observation.live_scope: Combined 0.8.7-r1: expected-active observations after Nexus load and exit; observer continued until native preview/emote at 13.89 s for load and time limit at 15.02 s for exit. Player separately confirmed both visible pets. No failed-spawn/removal diagnosis or retry.

known_manual_attribution_issue.scope: Historical 0.4.4 accepted non-CAS queues could overwrite a favorite without evidence of a manual choice. A native pet-battle restore reaches that queue, but the actual caller behind the 0.7.1 arena report was not captured. The 0.4.5 source now requires a matching successful native UI action and accepted nested queue before persistence.
known_manual_attribution_issue.later_native_snapshot: Location14, active=-1 and pending=-1 in two stable external read-only samples at2026-09-27T22:40:26+02:00. Earlier appearance cannot be inferred.
known_manual_attribution_issue.validation_scope: Offline regression and exact-build call-path review. Later 0.8.4 registration and other live results do not verify manual-attribution acceptance.

known_hud_issue.candidate_hides_icon_containers: Only when no ready icon is available.
known_hud_issue.scope: Running 0.4.7 / 0.8.4 includes optional owned notification icons and text-only fallback. Six setting-role icons are visible in screenshots, but parent/notice rendering and the white-disc outcome remain unconfirmed. Unlaunched 0.4.8 / 0.8.5 changes no HUD behavior.

previous_044_live_evidence.gameplay_verification_scope: One Random-mode Anomaly startup is now confirmed for 0.4.4 / 0.7.1. On 27 September 2026, load arming at 22:23:39.698 led to native queue acceptance at 22:23:42.250 (logged 2.56 seconds). The new observer recorded the expected active companion at 22:23:42.266, on its first update, then stopped. The player confirmed visible appearance. No ship exit or automatic retry preceded this result. This is one successful run, not a fix for the earlier intermittent failure; only passive diagnostics changed.

post_queue_observation.live_scope: One expected-active terminal observation on the first callback after Anomaly load queue acceptance. Player corroborated appearance. Queue-loss, timeout, cancellation and repeated-run live paths remain unverified.

developer_native_menu_trial.scope: Existing native toggle with a version-pinned bridge to production 0.4.4. The new production adds passive post-queue diagnostics only. The live 0.7.0 folder remains untouched. The white HUD disc is unresolved.

manual_attribution_issue.scope: The accepted queue hook classifies every non-CAS automatic call as manual. A game pet-battle restore path reaches this hook. In 0.7.1 a reported arena notice coincided with a persisted favorite change, but the actual live caller and user intent were not recorded.
manual_attribution_issue.later_native_snapshot: Location14, active=-1 and pending=-1 in two stable external read-only samples at2026-09-27T22:40:26+02:00. Earlier appearance cannot be inferred.

manual_choice_attribution.requires: Paired native UI dispatch, one nested accepted local queue, same thread/slot/copied identity/save context/epoch, unchanged pending slot and original literal True result.
manual_choice_attribution.unclassified_queue: Cancel automatic intent; preserve favorite and do not issue selection feedback.
manual_choice_attribution.learning_failure: Stop manual learning only; preserve native actions and existing automatic summoning.
